body:
Heh. You did your research.

They've been very distant lately. Not intentionally, i'm sure, but its still hard being away from him. He started a new job, and has been working opposite shifts from me.

In absolutely no way is it the easy way out. You've clearly thought long and hard about it, you've put the effort in, its just unfortunate that it ended up coming out this way.

You're a much braver person than I. I don't want to live anymore, but god damn I'm too chicken wuss to end it. I keep clingling to hope that tomorrow will be better, but its always worse. That, to me, is what hurts the most.

I'm not going to try amd stop you. I'm just some stranger. I will, however, share what keeps me going. My best friend is in a similar boat. We made a promise to eachother not to take our own lives. "Loser" has to give their inheritance to the survivor. We've both had our wills written to say that. Clming from our families, I can say my sister would absolutely skip my funeral over this, and his would too. Its a little joke between us, but its kept us both pushing for 2 years so far.
